gloss: ward office; municipal office of a city ward

definitions.gloss: ward office; municipal office of a city ward
definitions.explanation: The local government office that handles administrative services for a ward ({区|く}) in a major city. Provides services such as resident registration, family register, tax, insurance, and other civic procedures.

examples.japanese: {区役所|くやくしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{住民票|じゅうみんひょう}→住民票：09628_juuminhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: To get a certificate of residence at the ward office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}したら→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧{区役所|くやくしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{届|とど}け{出|で}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: After moving, you must file a notification at the ward office.

examples.japanese: {区役所|くやくしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{平日|へいじつ}→平日：03033_heijitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{午前|ごぜん}→午前：00548_gozen⟧{八時半|はちじはん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧{五時|ごじ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{開|あ}いている→開く：00689_aku⟧。
examples.english: The ward office counter is open from 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM on weekdays.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{区|く}→〜区：01997_ku⟧ (ward) and ⟦{役所|やくしょ}→役所：06455_yakusho⟧ (government office). The administrative center for a ⟦{区|く}→〜区：01997_ku⟧ (ward) within designated cities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {区役所|くやくしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to the ward office
- {区役所|くやくしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧: ward office counter
- {区役所|くやくしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to complete procedures at the ward office
- {区役所|くやくしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}け{出|で}る→届け出る：05910_todokederu⟧: to file a notification at the ward office

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧: city hall — for cities without wards
- {区役所|くやくしょ}: ward office — for wards within major cities
- ⟦{町役場|まちやくば}→町役場：13579_machiyakuba⟧: town hall — for smaller towns
- ⟦{村役場|むらやくば}→村役場：24018_murayakuba⟧: village hall — for villages
- ⟦{役所|やくしょ}→役所：06455_yakusho⟧: government office — general term

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, many important life events require visits to the {区役所|くやくしょ}: registering births, marriages, and deaths; reporting a change of address; obtaining a ⟦{住民票|じゅうみんひょう}→住民票：09628_juuminhyou⟧ (certificate of residence) or ⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧⟦{証明書|しょうめいしょ}→証明書：09785_shoumeisho⟧ (seal registration certificate). Foreign residents also use the {区役所|くやくしょ} for residence card procedures.
